title: Chosen Before Birth
story:
A young boy once looked at an old family photo album.

He saw pictures of his parents before he was born.

He asked,

“Did you think about me before I was born?”

His mother smiled.

She said,

“Yes, we dreamed about you long before you arrived.”

“We prepared a place for you.”

“We already loved you before we saw you.”

The boy sat quietly, surprised.

He had always thought he came by chance.

But now he realized he was planned and loved.

In life, many people feel accidental.

Unwanted.

Unknown.

Unimportant.

But God says something different.

Before we were born.

Before we took our first breath.

He already knew us.

He formed us with purpose.

And He called us with intention.
life_lesson:
You are not an accident.

God knew you and chose you before you were born.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for knowing me before I was born.

Thank You for creating me with purpose.

Help me to understand my identity in You.

Remove every feeling of worthlessness.

Let me walk confidently in Your calling.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Do you ever feel like your life has no clear purpose?

How does knowing God chose you before birth change your identity?

What purpose might God be calling you to today?
verse:
Before I formed you in the womb I knew you.
Before you were born I set you apart.
